_doc: Read by engine/hooks/pre_tool_use.py. mcp: every MCP tool is blocked unless an entry's tool glob matches its full name (mcp__<server>__<tool>). shell: commands matching an entry's regex pattern are blocked unless its conditions hold. Optional conditions on any entry: job_types, states, gate (a valid token for the active job). Empty lists mean no MCP tools and no extra shell gates.
